meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,你描述想要的动态效果,Claude 就会自动规划方案、准备素材、设计并构建动画,检查无误后问你先预览还是直接渲染,最终给你 MP4 或透明背景的视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想要一个几秒钟的动态图形视频(如文字动画、数字滚动、图表动画等),并且没有旁白或真人出镜时,这个技能会接管。如果内容更长、需要旁白或多场景,则交给 /general-video。

say.text: 做个数字从0涨到100万的动画,配个圆环
say.note: Claude 会按数字统计类别制作该动画。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态字幕,逐个字弹出
say.note: Claude 会使用动态文字模板构建。

say.text: 用这个标志做个品牌过场动画
say.note: Claude 会先获取你的标志素材,再做品牌过场。

howto.what_en: Claude can create short motion graphics (kinetic text, count-ups, charts, maps, etc.) from your request. It plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, then asks preview-or-render, outputting MP4 or transparent overlay video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a short motion graphic (typically under 10s, no narration or live actors). Longer, narrated, or multi-scene pieces go to /general-video; unclear requests go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an animation counting up to 1 million with a ring chart.
say_en.note: Claude uses the stat category to build it.

say_en.text: Turn this sentence into kinetic typography, one word at a time.
say_en.note: Claude uses kinetic-type for the text animation.

say_en.text: Make a logo sting with this logo ending on the brand lockup.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the asset and builds a logo-reveal.
